structured_output.mechanisms: Time is roughly steps × batch × per-sample compute (conv FLOPs across the three stages, scaled down by the low-resolution phases) plus a small per-step overhead and a fixed cost. Muon and cutout add overhead. Accuracy rises with epochs and width. Low-resolution phases, cutout, translate4, random flip and no label smoothing cost accuracy. Muon adds accuracy. The 75.3% threshold sits close to most runs, so feasibility is marginal.
